findings.title: Account UI message switched to Java MessageFormat
findings.body: error-invalid-multivalued-size in the account UI bundle was changed from i18next placeholders ({{0}}, {{1}}, {{2}}) to Java MessageFormat ({0}, {1}, {2} plus a {2,choice,...} pattern). Every other string in this file uses {{...}}. The account UI will not substitute the attribute name or limits and will show the literal choice pattern to users when a multivalued attribute fails size validation.

findings.title: Admin UI message switched to Java MessageFormat
findings.body: The admin UI bundle's error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed from {{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}} to Java {0}/{1}/{2} and a ChoiceFormat fragment. Admin UI messages are interpolated with the {{ }} syntax, not java.text.MessageFormat, so this validation error will render unsubstituted placeholders and the raw choice pattern in the admin console.

findings.title: Illegal-HTML report can throw and abort the build
findings.body: When sanitized text differs from the original, the prefix/suffix trim can overlap (for example value "xx" and sanitized "x", or any case where the removed span is made of the same characters as the surrounding text). start + end then exceeds the string length and value.substring / sanitized.substring throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. That RuntimeException is not caught by verify(), so the theme verifier crashes instead of recording the HTML violation.

findings.title: Lithuanian TOTP step replaced with Italian
findings.body: loginTotpStep1 in the Lithuanian login bundle was replaced with the Italian sentence "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:" instead of a Lithuanian translation of the new English text. Lithuanian users setting up OTP will be shown Italian instructions.

findings.title: Lithuanian account TOTP step replaced with Italian
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Lithuanian account bundle was replaced with the same Italian sentence ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:") rather than Lithuanian. The account console will show Italian setup instructions to Lithuanian users.
